claim_statement: OT loss and refinement efficacy: Claim that replacing LOT with MSE degrades drastically and removing refinement degrades 4.7 to 7.2. Bidirectional SW/EBSW OT loss and entropic adaptive refinement are necessary for best accuracy.

testability.rationale: Claim is empirical ablation (MSE vs BiSW/BiEBSW LOT and refinement 4.7→7.2 on SHREC19 after FAUST+SCAPE training) requiring full unsupervised pipeline: DiffusionNet feature extractor, FM solver, proper losses, and Sinkhorn refinement. Cannot be replicated by small CPU synthetic experiment in <10min without training and real mesh geometry.
testability.suggested_benchmark: No feasible <10min CPU synthetic benchmark can validate dataset-specific 4.7→7.2 degradation; conceptual proxy would be synthetic Gaussian-mixture point-cloud matching comparing MSE vs Monte-Carlo BiSW/BiEBSW + Sinkhorn, but would not test paper's SHREC19 numbers.
testability.unavailable_detail: Requires FAUST, SCAPE, SHREC19 remeshed collections (10K/20K vertices), pretrained DiffusionNet, FM solver and joint training weights from Table 4 [table-4] / Sec.6; real mean geodesic errors are dataset-specific and not inferable from synthetic data.
